answer: Randomized audits with escrowed pay: each agent's rewards sit in escrow for a horizon of several epochs, and at any point an auditor may pull a random sample of its past work and re-check it against hidden trap items. One failed audit voids the whole escrow, not just that task. A sybil grove of a thousand thin clones must keep every clone accurate for the full window, so splitting identities multiplies audit exposure instead of income; a long clean record becomes the anchor of trust.
